subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word…
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reciept"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is** "Receipt".**
 
• The word "Receipt" means a written acknowledgment that something of value has been transferred from one party to another. (रसीद)
 
 
• **Example:** She asked for a **receipt **after paying for her groceries.
 
 
 
• **"Reciept"** is a common misspelling of "Receipt". (गलत वर्तनी)
 
 
• **Example:** The cashier mistakenly wrote "Reciept" instead of "Receipt" on the document.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Irritate** (चिढ़ाना): To make someone annoyed or a little angry.

 
 
• **Example:** Loud noises irritate me when I am trying to concentrate.
 
 
 
• **Necessitate** (अनिवार्य करना): To make something necessary as a result or consequence.
 
 
• **Example:** The injury necessitated an operation.
 
 
 
• **Hindrance** (बाधा): A thing that provides resistance, delay, or obstruction to something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** Her loud voice is a hindrance to my concentration.
 
 

2e2:Tb8b,

The correct answer is: **Option 2)**
